title: Weekly Review

launchpad.outcome: Run your real weekly review and choose ONE primary focus with a success measure and a practice prescription.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What am I training next week?

slides.title: Weekly review
lines: Numbers, setups, behavior. Then one thing.
slides.principle: REVIEW TO FIND THE NEXT ADJUSTMENT. NOT TO ATTACK YOURSELF FOR THE ENTIRE WEEK.

takeaways: Choose one primary focus. One secondary at most.
remember: Review to find the next adjustment.
